name: REVIVER v21
notes: Your screen list: choose which screens the screen button goes through and in what order, from the Screens tab (KPM, clock and the Hexcore Link logo can come back if you want them). Every screen package gets a screen of its own; package screens only come up while TENET Hub is running. Keeps everything from v20: changeable boot logo (TENET 70 by default), the image screen for images and GIFs stored on the keyboard, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
